newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 21.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Renault chairman Louis Schweitzer says in an interview he is seeking to become Europe's most cost-competitive carmaker by the year 2000, has luanched restructuring plan including up to 3,000 job cuts per year.

-- Credit Lyonnais chairman Jean Peyrelevade says in an interview its 202-million-franc 1996 profit is a token of the bank's structural return to profitability, adds he expects state earnings from a privatisation expected within two years to be higher than state recapitalisation amounts.
-- Bouygues and Lyonnaise des Eaux consider partnership in telecommunications.
-- Credit Foncier recapitalisation needs estimated between 1.5 and two billion francs by government-appointed mediator Philippe Rouvillois.
